description: The 187 DrawingML preset shapes (ECMA-376 Part 1, ST_ShapeType) as reference data for engines (shapes SH-01): per preset, avLst (adjust values and their defaults), gdLst (guides and their formulas), ahLst (adjust handles with their ranges), cxnLst (connection sites), rect (the text rectangle; absent means the whole shape) and pathLst (paths with w/h, fill, stroke and extrusionOk, and the commands moveTo, lnTo, arcTo, quadBezTo, cubicBezTo and close). Values are the standard's own: guide names or integer literals, 1/100000 for adjust fractions and 60000ths of a degree for angles. Generated by scripts/build-preset-geometry.mjs; never edit by hand. The evaluator is packages/javascript/src/shape-geometry.ts.
